subject.title: Control UI shows "Control UI did not start" during gateway restart and cannot self-recover

question: Which open candidate should maintainers treat as the canonical fix path for this Control UI fallback recovery bug?
rationale: Two open pull requests reference this issue; one has stronger proof but conflicts with current main, while the other has prior correctness and proof blockers, so a maintainer should choose the adoption path rather than queueing another issue-level repair job.

options.title: Adopt the proven retry PR
options.body: Prioritize rebasing and reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99111 because it has real built-Control-UI proof and no current blocking finding in the prior review.

options.title: Repair the competing PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99172 to revise the retry mechanism and provide real built-browser proof before reconsidering it.

options.title: Close both and replace
options.body: If neither branch is practical to land, close the competing branches and queue a narrow replacement that preserves the source authors' credit.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proven retry PR
recommendation.body: Prioritize rebasing and reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99111 because it has real built-Control-UI proof and no current blocking finding in the prior review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on the original Control UI and Gateway serving boundary that this recovery path crosses.
